verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents first-party migration paths: automatic (lazy) migration via import mode on a custom database connection that moves users as they log in, which implicitly keeps their existing passwords, plus bulk imports for database connections. Missing for 10: competitor-specific migration guides (e.g., Cognito or Firebase), an explicit statement that password hashes are preserved in bulk imports so no reset is needed, and independent hands-on corroboration of a no-reset migration.
